result.topic_en: Euler states Lemma I on the equilibrium of an arbitrary elastic rod under forces applied to each element, and gives the equilibrium equation relating the applied forces to the elastic moment V/r.

Lemma I.

Tab. II. Fig. 3. §. 1. Si virgae vtcunque elafticae EYF in fingulis elementis potentiae quaecunque fuerint applicatae, ftatum aequilibrii definire.

Solutio.

Referatur virga ad axem fixum OV, et pro eius puncto quocunque Y ftatuantur coordinatae orthogonales $OX = x$ et $XY = y$, portio autem virgae $EY = s$, vt fit $ds^2 = dx^2 + dy^2$; tum vero elementi $Yy = ds$ fit maffa $= S\,ds$, ac in eodem loco elafticitas abfoluta $= V$, ita vt, pofito radio ofculi $= r$, vis, feu potius momentum elafticitatis fit $= \frac{V}{r}$; hincque, loco $r$ fubftituta formula differentiali, iftud momentum erit
$$= \frac{V(dy\,ddx - dx\,ddy)}{ds^3},$$
vbi fcilicet nullum differentiale pro conftanti eft affumtum. Deinde omnes potentiae, quibus hoc elementum $Yy$ follicitatur, refoluantur fecundum directiones coordinatarum, ac ponatur vis inde fecundum directionem YP refultans $= P\,ds$ et fecundum directionem $YQ = Q\,ds$: quibus pofitis pro ftatu aequilibrii requiritur, vt fit
$$\int dy \int P\,ds - \int dx \int Q\,ds = V\left(\frac{dy\,ddx - dx\,ddy}{ds^3}\right).$$
Praeter

items.english: If arbitrary forces are applied to the individual elements of an arbitrarily elastic rod EYF, to determine the state of equilibrium.
